title: EvidenceAsset (DRAFT)
description: An immutable stored original — a photograph, document or recording — identified by its content digest. DRAFT — not approved.

checksumSha256.description: Computed by the client before upload and verified by the server against the stored object. Two uploads of identical bytes are one asset.

status.description: Only 'verified' assets may be cited. 'withheld' hides an asset from serving without deleting it — see open question 5.

storageKey.description: Opaque object storage key. Never a public URL: access is always brokered through a short-lived signed URL after a permission check.

capturedAt.description: When the photograph was taken, which may be long before it was uploaded (ADR-028 offline capture).

capturedBy.description: Party or actor who captured it.

captureLocation.description: Where it was captured, if the device recorded it. Subject to TREE-003 precision reduction on read.

dataClassification.description: A photograph showing a person or dwelling is not public. ADR-016 may require cultural_restricted.

_note: EXIF is deliberately not modeled as structured fields. Camera metadata routinely contains precise GPS and device identifiers; extracting it into queryable columns would spread location data the platform is otherwise careful to reduce.
